plan.summary: Outbound /api/v1/internal/ peer-service endpoint'leri (optout + outbox/retry-skipped) JWT middleware tarafindan 401'leniyordu cunku Backend proxy yalniz X-Internal-Service-Token gonderiyor (Bearer JWT yok), endpoint'ler ise /api/v1/ altinda JWT-required prefix'te. UseJwtAuth exclusion overload'ina gecilip /api/v1/internal/ JWT'den haric tutuldu (FEAT-LIW /api/v1/leads/intake/ pattern'i). Handler'in shared-secret check'i artik calisir.
plan.q_intent: Refactor audit Batch 5 — Outbound internal-endpoint erisimi (C8). 'Once FALSE-POZITIF mi teyit et; gercekse internal auth path.' Teyit: GERCEK bug (false-positive degil). Q karari (AskUserQuestion): Fix A = Outbound JWT exclusion. Auth-path -> MUST-ASK alindi.
plan.interview_notes: TEYIT ZINCIRI: (1) JwtAuthMiddleware.InvokeAsync RequiresAuth(path)=true ise gecerli Bearer JWT yoksa 401 doner (satir 69-77). (2) Outbound Program.cs:301 UseJwtAuth(jwtValidator, logger, '/api/v1/') params-only overload -> authExcludedPrefixes BOS. /api/v1/internal/optout + /api/v1/internal/outbox/retry-skipped '/api/v1/' ile baslar -> JWT required. (3) Backend Program.cs:9422-9425 + 9449-9453: httpClientFactory.CreateClient() taze client + yalniz X-Internal-Service-Token header (Authorization YOK, JWT mint YOK). FEAT-LIW (Automation->Backend) JWT mint ediyor ama FEAT-J2 (Backend->Outbound) ETMIYOR -> false-positive kosulu saglanmiyor -> GERCEK bug. FIX dogrulamasi: JWT skip -> TenantContext null -> FeatureGuardMiddleware.cs:57-62 null-context pass-through -> handler shared-secret check calisir. Sadece bu iki endpoint /api/v1/internal/ altinda, ikisi de shared-secret-gated + secret bos iken fail-closed.

acceptance_criteria.verification_note: FeatureGuardMiddleware.cs:57-62 okundu: tenantCtx==null -> await _next(context); return. Internal endpoint plan-feature gate'ine takilmaz.

verification_questions.question: Exclusion yalniz amaclanan iki internal endpoint'i kapsiyor mu — /api/v1/internal/ altinda JWT-korunmasi-gereken baska endpoint yok mu? Iki endpoint de X-Internal-Service-Token + InternalServices:SharedSecret ile gated ve secret bos iken fail-closed (401) mi?

JWT skip edilince TenantContext null kalir; FeatureGuard (UseFeatureGuard '/api/v1/' -> 'Outbound') bu durumda request'i blocklar mi yoksa pass-through mu yapar? Middleware sirasi (JWT exclusion -> FeatureGuard null-context bypass -> handler shared-secret) dogru mu?

Davranis korunuyor mu: baska /api/v1/ endpoint'leri (templates, projects, broadcasts...) hala JWT-gated mi — required prefix '/api/v1/' korundu, yalniz exclusion mi eklendi? webhook IP whitelist davranisi (Outbound'da bos HashSet) degismedi mi?

tenant_id trust boundary: internal endpoint payload.tenant_id otoritatif (caller shared-secret ile authenticated + Backend proxy /api/v1/optout JWT-bound tenant'i resolve edip forward ediyor) — bu trust model exclusion sonrasi hala gecerli mi, cross-tenant yazma riski olusmuyor mu?
